fact: The Council of Ministers of 17 April 2025 unveiled an agreement with SOS Telecom to deploy optical fibre in Lobaye, Mambéré-Kadéï and Ouham-Pendé prefectures and on the Bangui-Bambari axis, to improve connectivity in isolated areas.
title: Développement numérique et infrastructures en Centrafrique : avancées et défis
